remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment in a convenient Norwalk location. Featuring luxury vinyl plank flooring, fresh neutral paint, abundant natural light, and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, this move-in-ready rental offers both comfort and style. The spacious living room flows into a large eat-in kitchen with ample cabinetry and counter space, while both bedrooms provide comfortable living and flexible use. Tenants can also enjoy access to the beautifully maintained backyard. Ideally located near shopping, dining, public transportation, and major highways. Excellent credit, verifiable income, and references are required. Schedule your private showing today!
